title: Teammate restoration R versus within-pre placebo
project: When a Hub Sits (Paper 2) / Lineup Adaptation
hypothesis: After a hub sits, teammates restore the deleted structural direction (restoration R) more than a within-pre-window placebo that deletes the player while he is still present.
design: 148 spells. gate.py: R = <Delta, d>/|d|^2 on unit 28-cell fingerprints, real (late-pre vs spell) vs placebo (early-pre vs late-pre with player deleted); franchise bootstrap. gate2.py (final): cross-fit so d comes from r1 and C2 from r2, removing shared-noise bias found in gate.py.
primary_result: gate.py all spells n=148: G2 R real mean +0.580 (median +0.616) vs placebo +0.428, paired difference +0.151 [+0.050, +0.256]; G2 O difference +0.056 [+0.034, +0.080]. L_pre>=0.02 n=53: R difference +0.177 [-0.008, +0.397]; L_pre>=0.05 n=21: +0.198 [-0.072, +0.497]. gate2.py (final) all spells: R real +0.186 [+0.106, +0.271] vs placebo +0.013 [-0.045, +0.072], difference +0.173 [+0.085, +0.262]; T (teammate response distance) difference +0.012 [-0.004, +0.030]. L_pre>=0.02: R difference +0.140 [-0.035, +0.304]; L_pre>=0.05: +0.140 [-0.087, +0.385]. G1 scaling median 0.0070 vs Monte Carlo noise 0.0053, 95th pct 0.0201, sampling null ~0.078.
failure_evidence: Cross-fitted R difference +0.173 [+0.085, +0.262] vs placebo on n=148; T difference CI includes 0.
notes: gate2 is the final estimator (gate.py R was inflated by shared-noise bias: 0.580 vs 0.186). Mean R still exceeds placebo after the fix; the high-L subsets have CIs that include 0. T is null. Reliability is TMP-034.

title: SCOUT primary gates P1/P2/P3: SI as opponent play-type scout
project: When a Hub Sits (Paper 2) / opponent scouting
hypothesis: Structural Influence improves a held-out forecast of what an offense will run after a hub sits (P1 play-type mix, P2 relationships, P3 displacement magnitude) beyond conventional features, under a Holm family with a bootstrap CI that must exclude 0.
design: 148 spells, 28 franchises, 2022-23 to 2024-25 (51/43/54); evaluation = spell games 6 onward, 2,909 team-games, 260,630 typed possessions. LOFO 28 franchise folds; F0-F3 log-loss chain; G0/G1 fingerprint distances; ridge C vs C+SI for Y1 displacement and Y2 staleness with 1,000 franchise-block permutations of L_pre. Integrity I1-I3 required before tests.
primary_result: I1 label agreement 0.9910 PASS; I2 pbp+rotation 1.000, matchups 0.999, poss_meta 1.000; I3 absent ids 1.000. P1 LL(F2)-LL(F3) mean +0.00002 95% CI [-0.00007, +0.00009] sign-flip p=0.7245, Holm p=0.8703, gap closure +0.0008 [-0.0043, +0.0048] vs 0.10 threshold. P2 dist(G0)-dist(G1) +0.00323 [-0.00503, +0.01059] p=0.4352, G1 beats G0 in 49%, mean dist G0 0.1445 G1 0.1413 noise floor 0.0852. P3 Y1 R2_oos C +0.1212, C+SI +0.1561, delta +0.0349 [-0.0582, +0.1172], perm p=0.0100, Holm p=0.0300. P3 Y2 delta -0.0159 p=0.7133. Forward chaining n=97 does not change conclusions. F1 mechanical removal +0.00009 p=0.8019; F1-F2 learned retention +0.00057 p=0.0017; F3b worse than F2L by -0.00529 p=0.0001.
failure_evidence: Holm-adjusted: P1 p=0.8703 pass=False, P2 p=0.8703 pass=False, P3_Y1 p=0.0300 pass=False (bootstrap CI includes 0). P1 gap closure 0.08% vs 10% practical threshold.
power_info: n=148 spells; evaluation 260,630 possessions; attainable F0-to-oracle log-loss range 0.019 nats; practical P1 threshold 0.10 gap closure
notes: RESULTS_REPORT: SI does not give an opponent usable play-type information. The F0-to-oracle ceiling of 0.019 nats (~1%) was knowable from the evaluation set before comparing F2 vs F3. 2024-25 inferrer share falls 42 pp (sd 28) between pre and spell; P1/P2 remain null in every season.

title: SCOUT secondary tests S1-S4 and D1
project: When a Hub Sits (Paper 2) / opponent scouting
hypothesis: Higher L_pre means the post-absence offense is less predictable from pre-absence information (S1), early spell film plus SI helps more (S2), efficiency changes with L_pre (S3), and defenses exploit SI-flagged absences (S4).
design: Same 148 spells. S1 leave-one-game-out dPred, partial rho with L_pre; label-free shot-zone and initiator versions. S2 Dirichlet updates k=1..5 from F2 vs F3; T3 initiator prior. S3 partial rho of d_ppp/d_tov/d_ftr/d_xps/d_resid with L_pre (stated MDE rho about 0.23). S4 matchup-time attention vs initiation change. D1 cell changes, unexpected share, within-spell instability.
primary_result: S1 all labels partial rho=-0.187 [-0.344, -0.041] perm p=0.0235, pass rule False; conf>=0.75 rho=-0.070 p=0.4273; shot zones +0.062 p=0.4633; initiator identity +0.131 p=0.1184. S2 F2 vs F3 k=1..5 all differences ~0.0000, p>=0.1374; T3 initiator gain +0.13395 (k=1) to +0.30879 (k=5), partial rho with L_pre -0.024 to -0.112. S3 d_ppp rho=-0.040 [-0.212, +0.166] p=0.6187; d_tov +0.033 p=0.7011; d_ftr +0.161 p=0.0605; d_xps -0.073 p=0.4018; d_resid +0.091 p=0.3048; pool N=915 partial rho(L_season, dPPP | d_opp)=-0.087. S4 within-team rho(init change, attention change)=+0.9176 [+0.9062, +0.9281]; convergence games 1-5 vs 6+ +0.5377; L_pre moderation -0.169 p=0.0440. D1 unexpected share median 0.938; mean cos(pred, realized)=+0.179; instability +0.0519 p=0.0020.
failure_evidence: S1 pass=False: the negative rho is carried by play-type labels (high-confidence and label-free shot-zone/initiator versions lose the effect or reverse sign). S2 SI increment is ~0; S3 all CIs include 0 (MDE rho ~0.23).
power_info: n=148; S3 MDE rho about 0.23; S3 robustness pool N=915
notes: S4 attention tracking (+0.92) is mechanical with usage, not evidence of exploitation. T3 shows early film on who initiates is informative (+0.13 nats after one game) but not moderated by L_pre. Label-leakage (TMP-007) made an S1 label artifact knowable in advance.

design: NBA API audit of playbyplayv3 vs gamerotation; 10-game then 15-game-per-season play-type samples vs yy=22; PBP roster proxy for presence; projection from yy=22-24 yield (~49 spells/season). Full reconstruction and gate.py on the expanded pool were specified but not completed.
